headline: Democrats win 258 seats, taking the largest US House majority since 1992
label: NEWS
caption:
US politics has seen a major shift following the latest midterm election results 🇺🇸

Democrats have secured their largest US House majority since 1992 after flipping a seat in North Carolina, according to reports by BBC and Reuters.

BBC reported that Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterm elections, while Republicans hold at least 173 seats.

The historic election results set the stage for a major political tussle with Donald Trump, according to the Times of Israel.

Firstpost reported that the expanded majority marks the largest seat sweep for the Democratic party in over three decades.
